#  Suggest an Idea for LiteBrowser

Have an idea that could make LiteBrowser better?

I'd love to hear your suggestions!

Use this section to:
- Suggest new features.
- Recommend improvements to existing features.
- Suggest customisation options.
- Share ideas that could improve performance.
- Suggest quality-of-life improvements.

### Before submitting:
- Check if someone has already suggested the same idea.
- Explain how your idea would work.
- Describe why you think it would be useful.

Every suggestion is appreciated, and your feedback helps shape the future of LiteBrowser!

**Thank you for helping make LiteBrowser better!**
